GOLD COAST / COMMERCIAL SERVICES

Cleaning, waste & hygiene

We define cleaning and waste work by the area, material and operating requirements of the premises. We coordinate access to shared spaces, amenities and service areas, and identify the waste stream before arranging removal. Routine cleaning and specialist contamination work are quoted as distinct scopes.

What we can look after

  • Shared-area, amenity and agreed commercial cleaning.
  • Post-maintenance clean-up and work-area presentation.
  • Waste collection, segregation and removal within the agreed scope.

Planning the work

  1. We confirm the cleaning areas, site rules and waste types.
  2. We agree products, equipment, storage and collection access.
  3. We check the completed areas and record agreed waste and cleaning tasks.

Questions about this service

Is waste removal included in every repair?+

We state the waste allowance in the quote. We identify the expected materials and quantities, access and disposal needs, so the agreed clean-up and any separate removal work are clear before the job.
